column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 24 (E99014): Tokarev bertemu Doll buangan yang mencuri identitasnya,
# lalu mendirikan Griffin Mutual Aid Society; bertahun-tahun kemudian konvoi bantuan ke Mokosh.
# Tetap Inggris: Tokarev, Betty, Abigail, Betis, IDW, Commander, Welrod, Varjagers, Griffin,
# URNC, Doll, Liushih, Springfield, Lee-Enfield, Kuro, Florence, Dandelion, Frame,
# neural cloud, Universal Anything Services, Kalin, S09, Griffin Mutual Aid Society,
# Integration Mutual Aid Society, Mokosh, Green Zone, Yellow Zone, Griffin Alumni Association.
(A hidden safehouse in the Green Zone, near the Yellow Zone.)
column2: (Sebuah safehouse tersembunyi di Green Zone, dekat Yellow Zone.)

column1: (The heavy metal security door is pushed open with a dry mechanical friction sound. Dragging her exhausted body, Tokarev finally returns to this residence she has been away from for a month. The air is filled with the stuffiness of not being ventilated for a long time, but to her, this place means rare safety and tranquility.)
column2: (Pintu pengaman logam yang berat itu didorong terbuka dengan bunyi gesekan mekanis yang kering. Menyeret tubuhnya yang kelelahan, Tokarev akhirnya kembali ke kediaman yang sudah sebulan dia tinggalkan. Udaranya pengap karena lama tidak diberi ventilasi, tapi bagi dia tempat ini berarti keamanan dan ketenangan yang langka.)

column1: (Flop—)
column2: (Bruk—)

column1: (She doesn't even take off her dust-covered coat, practically crashing straight onto the sofa, burying her face deeply into the soft headrest without caring about her image.)
column2: (Dia bahkan tidak melepas mantelnya yang berlumur debu, praktis langsung menghempas diri ke sofa, membenamkan wajahnya dalam-dalam ke sandaran kepala yang empuk tanpa peduli penampilannya.)

column1: Phew... finally back... I didn't expect a missing persons investigation mission to take so long...
column2: Fyuh... akhirnya pulang... aku tidak menyangka misi penyelidikan orang hilang bisa selama itu...

column1: Thanks to the help of Betty and Abigail... otherwise, it would have been real trouble in the Yellow Zone this time.
column2: Berkat bantuan Betty dan Abigail... kalau tidak, kali ini di Yellow Zone bisa jadi masalah besar.

column1: (Tokarev rolls over and takes out her information terminal from her clothes. The screen lights up, showing a group photo of her, Betis, and Abigail after the mission ended.)
column2: (Tokarev berguling dan mengeluarkan terminal informasinya dari balik pakaiannya. Layarnya menyala, menampilkan foto bersama dia, Betis, dan Abigail setelah misinya selesai.)

column1: (Thanks to their tacit cooperation, Tokarev's mission to investigate missing children in the Yellow Zone was completed without any major mishaps this time.)
column2: (Berkat kerja sama mereka yang tanpa banyak kata, misi Tokarev menyelidiki anak-anak yang hilang di Yellow Zone kali ini selesai tanpa kendala besar.)

column1: I didn't expect Miss IDW to become so reliable too... But her personality is as lively as ever.
column2: Aku tidak menyangka Miss IDW juga jadi begitu bisa diandalkan... Tapi sifatnya tetap selincah dulu.

column1: I wonder if the Commander and Miss Welrod will be surprised when they find out.
column2: Entah apa Commander dan Miss Welrod akan terkejut kalau tahu.

column1: But... I really didn't expect there to be such humans in the Yellow Zone... Selling their own flesh and blood to human traffickers just for vaccines. Even abducting children from other settlements to get more supplies... And they actually used abandoned Dolls as cover... Tsk...
column2: Tapi... aku benar-benar tidak menyangka ada manusia seperti itu di Yellow Zone... Menjual darah dagingnya sendiri ke penyelundup manusia cuma demi vaksin. Bahkan menculik anak dari permukiman lain demi pasokan tambahan... Dan mereka memakai Doll terbuang sebagai kedok... Cih...

column1: On top of that, the Varjagers' activities in the Yellow Zone are getting more and more rampant.
column2: Di atas itu semua, gerakan Varjagers di Yellow Zone makin lama makin merajalela.

column1: (Tokarev forces herself to sit up and, following the habit she developed during her time at Griffin, meticulously writes the process of this commission into a mission briefing and encrypts it for archiving.)
column2: (Tokarev memaksa dirinya duduk dan, mengikuti kebiasaan yang dia bentuk selama di Griffin, menulis proses penugasan ini jadi laporan misi dengan teliti lalu mengenkripsinya untuk diarsipkan.)

column1: Eh? This is already the 25th file of the third quarter... Have I actually taken on this many commissions this quarter?
column2: Eh? Ini sudah berkas ke-25 di kuartal ketiga... Ternyata sebanyak itu penugasan yang kuambil kuartal ini?

column1: (Tokarev swipes the interface of her terminal. She has too many channels for accepting commissions, and the information is complex. Helplessly, she can only close the task list and log into her private financial system instead.)
column2: (Tokarev menggeser antarmuka terminalnya. Kanal penerimaan penugasannya terlalu banyak, dan informasinya rumit. Tak berdaya, dia hanya bisa menutup daftar tugasnya dan masuk ke sistem keuangan pribadinya.)

column1: Without realizing it, I've saved up this much money. Let's deposit today's payment in batches too.
column2: Tanpa sadar aku sudah menabung sebanyak ini. Bayaran hari ini juga kusetor bertahap.

column1: (Her fingers dance rapidly across the screen, skillfully breaking down the massive sum in her account and depositing it into various hidden virtual accounts. These accounts are spread across different banking systems under URNC control and have completely different functions.)
column2: (Jarinya menari cepat di layar, dengan cekatan memecah jumlah besar di rekeningnya dan menyetorkannya ke berbagai rekening virtual tersembunyi. Rekening-rekening itu tersebar di sistem perbankan berbeda di bawah kendali URNC dan fungsinya sepenuhnya berbeda-beda.)

column1: (Short-term investments, long-term fixed deposits, and of course, mostly anonymous savings accounts that can be withdrawn at any time.)
column2: (Investasi jangka pendek, deposito jangka panjang, dan tentu saja, kebanyakan rekening tabungan anonim yang bisa ditarik kapan saja.)

column1: (Even to prepare for the most extreme emergencies, Tokarev had hoarded large amounts of hard currency and various physical currencies, categorized and stored in several safe houses she had established.)
column2: (Bahkan untuk bersiap menghadapi keadaan darurat paling ekstrem, Tokarev menimbun mata uang keras dalam jumlah besar dan berbagai mata uang fisik, dikelompokkan dan disimpan di beberapa safe house yang dia dirikan.)

column1: Just the current liquid funds on the books... are already enough to support the deep maintenance and operating costs of 20 civilian Dolls for half a year.
column2: Dana cair yang tercatat sekarang saja... sudah cukup menopang perawatan mendalam dan biaya operasional 20 Doll sipil selama setengah tahun.

column1: However—
column2: Namun—

column1: (Facing the string of numbers on the screen that would make anyone living in the Yellow Zone jealous, there was not a trace of excitement in Tokarev's eyes; instead, they were filled with deep confusion.)
column2: (Menghadapi deretan angka di layar yang bisa membuat siapa pun yang hidup di Yellow Zone iri, tidak ada setitik kegembiraan pun di mata Tokarev; sebaliknya matanya dipenuhi kebingungan yang dalam.)

column1: (In fact, this snowballing savings account had been planned since the day the "Griffin Alumni Association" was established.)
column2: (Sebenarnya rekening tabungan yang terus menggunung itu sudah direncanakan sejak hari "Griffin Alumni Association" didirikan.)

column1: (But just as she still doubts whether she is suited to be the president of the Alumni Association, to this day, Tokarev still doesn't know... exactly how to use this massive sum of funds.)
column2: (Tapi sama seperti dia masih meragukan apakah dia pantas jadi ketua Alumni Association, sampai hari ini Tokarev tetap tidak tahu... bagaimana tepatnya memakai dana sebesar itu.)

column1: (The Alumni Association hasn't made any substantial progress, and everyone just treats it as a chat platform. She has saved up so much money, but she doesn't know how to operate it.)
column2: (Alumni Association belum membuat kemajuan yang berarti, dan semua orang cuma menganggapnya wadah mengobrol. Dia menabung sebanyak itu, tapi tidak tahu bagaimana menjalankannya.)

column1: Commander, what are you doing right now?
column2: Commander, kau sedang apa sekarang?

column1: (Whenever the Commander is mentioned, a lingering question always hovers in Tokarev's heart—)
column2: (Setiap kali Commander disebut, sebuah pertanyaan selalu menggantung di hati Tokarev—)

column1: (How is he doing now? Has he encountered any danger?)
column2: (Bagaimana keadaannya sekarang? Apa dia menemui bahaya?)

column1: (Tokarev knows very well that the Commander cannot remain incognito in the Yellow Zone forever.)
column2: (Tokarev sangat tahu Commander tidak mungkin selamanya menyamar di Yellow Zone.)

column1: (There are still too many mistakes in this world, too many dark corners, and too many people swallowing injustice and enduring pain.)
column2: (Masih terlalu banyak kesalahan di dunia ini, terlalu banyak sudut gelap, dan terlalu banyak orang yang menelan ketidakadilan dan menahan sakit.)

column1: (She believed that the things she could see, the Commander also saw clearly and kept in mind. That person couldn't possibly just let things be; he would definitely return.)
column2: (Dia percaya hal-hal yang bisa dia lihat, Commander juga melihatnya jelas dan menyimpannya di hati. Orang itu mustahil membiarkannya begitu saja; dia pasti kembali.)

column1: In that case, when he decides to return, will he need manpower?
column2: Kalau begitu, saat dia memutuskan kembali, apa dia akan butuh tenaga?

column1: Facing a crisis all alone, wouldn't that be very lonely?
column2: Menghadapi krisis seorang diri, bukankah itu sangat sepi?

column1: At times like this, will he think of us?
column2: Di saat seperti itu, apa dia akan teringat pada kami?

column1: (Just thinking about this made Tokarev restless.)
column2: (Memikirkan itu saja sudah membuat Tokarev gelisah.)

column1: (She wanted to help the Commander, to make him realize that he wasn't alone.)
column2: (Dia ingin membantu Commander, membuatnya menyadari dia tidak sendirian.)

column1: (But what should she do?)
column2: (Tapi apa yang harus dia lakukan?)

column1: (If this money couldn't be converted into tangible assistance, then it was just a bunch of boring numerical codes.)
column2: (Kalau uang itu tidak bisa diubah jadi bantuan yang nyata, itu cuma setumpuk kode angka yang membosankan.)

column1: (When it came to fundraising and business operations, there were too many Dolls in the alumni association who were much better at it than she was.)
column2: (Soal penggalangan dana dan menjalankan bisnis, terlalu banyak Doll di alumni association yang jauh lebih pandai darinya.)

column1: (If Tokarev said today that she wanted to borrow a sum of money to help the Commander, Liushih, Springfield, and Lee-Enfield would definitely not hesitate to bring out an even more exaggeratedly huge sum.)
column2: (Kalau hari ini Tokarev bilang dia ingin meminjam sejumlah uang untuk membantu Commander, Liushih, Springfield, dan Lee-Enfield pasti tanpa ragu mengeluarkan jumlah yang jauh lebih besar lagi.)

column1: Everyone in the alumni association has already found their own goals, and they are all working hard in their own ways to be able to help when they reunite with the Commander.
column2: Semua orang di alumni association sudah menemukan tujuannya masing-masing, dan mereka semua bekerja keras dengan caranya sendiri supaya bisa membantu saat bertemu Commander lagi.

column1: Miss Springfield's cafe intelligence network, the underground streaming platform Kuro secretly built, and Florence wandering the Yellow Zone as an underground doctor... But what about me? What should I do?
column2: Jaringan intel kafe Miss Springfield, platform siaran bawah tanah yang dibangun diam-diam oleh Kuro, dan Florence yang berkeliling Yellow Zone sebagai dokter bawah tanah... Tapi aku? Aku harus apa?

column1: (Closing her eyes, Tokarev's mind was full of the past—opening her eyes, a field of ruins. The enemies were gone, Miss Dandelion was gone... even the Commander was gone...)
column2: (Menutup mata, kepala Tokarev penuh masa lalu—membuka mata, hamparan puing. Musuhnya sudah tidak ada, Miss Dandelion sudah tidak ada... bahkan Commander sudah tidak ada...)

column1: (Back then, she was too weak and could only help the Commander by lending out her frame...)
column2: (Waktu itu dia terlalu lemah dan hanya bisa membantu Commander dengan meminjamkan frame-nya...)

column1: (Now, how much stronger is she than back then?)
column2: (Sekarang, seberapa lebih kuat dia dibanding waktu itu?)

column1: ...I don't want to... just watch...
column2: ...Aku tidak mau... cuma menonton...

column1: (Self-blame and a sense of powerlessness spread through her neural cloud, followed by a bone-deep exhaustion.)
column2: (Rasa bersalah dan ketidakberdayaan menyebar di neural cloud-nya, disusul kelelahan yang menembus tulang.)

column1: (A full month of high-intensity continuous combat has pushed Tokarev's neural cloud to its breaking point. She curls up on the sofa and heavily closes her eyes.)
column2: (Sebulan penuh pertempuran berintensitas tinggi tanpa henti mendorong neural cloud Tokarev sampai titik patahnya. Dia meringkuk di sofa dan menutup matanya dengan berat.)

column1: Right... I still need to contact everyone later... I'll ask for everyone's opinions again...
column2: Benar... nanti aku masih harus menghubungi semuanya... akan kutanyakan lagi pendapat mereka...

column1: Ugh... how long have I been in sleep mode... is it almost time for the contact... hmm?
column2: Ugh... sudah berapa lama aku di mode tidur... apa sudah hampir waktunya kontak... hm?
（Klik——）

column1: (Almost in the same microsecond she opened her eyes, Tokarev subconsciously drew the sidearm at her waist relying on tactical instinct, her fire control module instantly surging from a silent state to full load operation.)
column2: (Nyaris di mikrodetik yang sama saat dia membuka mata, tanpa sadar Tokarev menarik pistol di pinggangnya mengandalkan insting taktis, modul kendali tembaknya seketika melonjak dari keadaan senyap ke beban penuh.)

column1: (This safe house was built by her personally, brick by brick. She was extremely clear about every layout here.)
column2: (Safe house itu dibangunnya sendiri, batu demi batu. Dia sangat hafal setiap tata letak di sini.)

column1: (And precisely because of this, she keenly noticed that someone had been here during her deep sleep.)
column2: (Justru karena itu, dia dengan tajam menyadari ada yang datang kemari saat dia tertidur lelap.)

column1: (Tokarev silently slid off the sofa, her muzzle locked tightly on the slightly open door, a trace of unbelievable helplessness flashing through her neural cloud.)
column2: (Tokarev turun dari sofa tanpa suara, ujung larasnya terkunci rapat pada pintu yang terbuka sedikit, segaris ketidakberdayaan yang sulit dipercaya berkelebat di neural cloud-nya.)

column1: A military-grade door lock was actually pried open silently... I didn't expect that in a state of extreme fatigue, I wouldn't notice it at all.
column2: Kunci pintu kelas militer ternyata bisa dicongkel tanpa suara... Aku tidak menyangka dalam keadaan sangat lelah aku sama sekali tidak menyadarinya.

column1: Let's first check what's missing... Ah... the backup communication device...
column2: Kuperiksa dulu apa yang hilang... Ah... perangkat komunikasi cadangannya...

column1: (She sweeps her peripheral vision across the desk. The place where the encrypted communication device was originally stored is empty. Along with it, her old ID from the Griffin era that she treasured at the bottom of the drawer, and the physical key terminal for her savings, have all vanished into thin air.)
column2: (Dia menyapu meja itu dengan sudut matanya. Tempat penyimpanan perangkat komunikasi terenkripsi itu kosong. Bersamanya, ID lamanya dari era Griffin yang dia simpan baik-baik di dasar laci, dan terminal kunci fisik tabungannya, semuanya lenyap begitu saja.)

column1: (Anger, this is an extremely rare emotion in Tokarev's usually gentle personality.)
column2: (Kemarahan, itu emosi yang sangat langka pada sifat Tokarev yang biasanya lembut.)

column1: Come out. I know you're still in this room. You took something you absolutely shouldn't have touched, please return it to me immediately.
column2: Keluar. Aku tahu kau masih di ruangan ini. Kau mengambil sesuatu yang sama sekali tidak boleh kau sentuh, tolong kembalikan sekarang juga.

column1: I am a tactical Doll, and my visual modules have firmly locked onto your position.
column2: Aku Doll taktis, dan modul penglihatanku sudah mengunci posisimu dengan kuat.

column1: If you don't plan to surrender, then... I will absolutely not show mercy.
column2: Kalau kau tidak berniat menyerah, maka... aku sama sekali tidak akan berbelas kasih.

column1: (Before Tokarev finishes counting down, an extremely petite dark figure darts out from the blind spot of the lockers like a startled wildcat, desperately trying to run towards the half-open door.)
column2: (Sebelum Tokarev selesai menghitung mundur, sebuah figur gelap yang sangat kecil melesat keluar dari titik buta lemari seperti kucing liar yang terkejut, mati-matian berlari ke arah pintu yang setengah terbuka.)

column1: (However, Tokarev is faster. She launches forward like an arrow released from a bowstring, sweeping a fierce low kick towards the uninvited guest's lower body, attempting to directly paralyze the opponent's mobility.)
column2: (Namun Tokarev lebih cepat. Dia melesat maju seperti anak panah yang lepas dari tali busur, menyapukan tendangan rendah yang ganas ke tubuh bagian bawah tamu tak diundang itu, mencoba langsung melumpuhkan mobilitas lawannya.)

column1: Hmm?
column2: Hm?

column1: (To Tokarev's surprise, her sure-hit strike was barely blocked by the enemy's arms. But that wasn't what surprised her the most—the tactile feedback at the moment their limbs collided told her that this uninvited guest was actually a Doll as well.)
column2: (Yang mengejutkan Tokarev, serangannya yang seharusnya pasti kena nyaris berhasil ditahan lengan lawannya. Tapi bukan itu yang paling mengejutkannya—umpan balik sentuhan saat tungkai mereka berbenturan memberitahunya bahwa tamu tak diundang itu ternyata juga seorang Doll.)

column1: (But the battle situation at this moment allowed her no hesitation. She took advantage of the momentum to twist her waist, launching a storm of continuous knee strikes and grappling techniques.)
column2: (Tapi situasi pertempuran saat itu tidak memberinya ruang untuk ragu. Dia memanfaatkan momentumnya untuk memutar pinggang, melancarkan badai tendangan lutut beruntun dan teknik kuncian.)

column1: (The continuous close-quarters combat left the intruder completely defenseless. In just three rounds, the opponent was heavily kicked to the ground by her, making a dull thud.)
column2: (Pertarungan jarak dekat yang bertubi-tubi itu membuat penyusupnya sepenuhnya tak bisa bertahan. Hanya dalam tiga rangkaian, lawannya ditendang keras ke lantai olehnya, menimbulkan bunyi gedebuk yang tumpul.)

column1: (The cold gun barrel was pressed firmly against the uninvited guest's chest.)
column2: (Laras yang dingin ditekan kuat ke dada tamu tak diundang itu.)

column1: (It wasn't until this moment that Tokarev finally had the chance to clearly see the full appearance of the person in front of her. The Doll before her was wearing a worn-out, faded cleaning uniform produced by 'Universal Anything Services'. Her bionic skin was covered in rough scratches and engine oil stains. Of course, the most important thing was that she had traces of her fire control core being removed.)
column2: (Baru pada saat itu Tokarev akhirnya sempat melihat jelas penampilan lengkap orang di depannya. Doll di hadapannya memakai seragam kebersihan lusuh dan pudar produksi 'Universal Anything Services'. Kulit bioniknya penuh goresan kasar dan noda oli mesin. Tentu, yang paling penting adalah ada bekas inti kendali tembaknya dicabut.)

column1: (This is a Tactical Doll who has lost her armaments and fire control core.)
column2: (Ini Doll taktis yang sudah kehilangan persenjataan dan inti kendali tembaknya.)

column1: No... don't... don't shoot...
column2: Jangan... jangan... jangan tembak...

column1: I-I don't want to be sent to the scrapyard... I don't want to be scrapped...
column2: A-aku tidak mau dikirim ke tempat rongsokan... aku tidak mau dirongsokkan...

column1: Judging by the strength of your frame, are you a Tactical Doll whose fire control core was forcibly removed previously...?
column2: Dilihat dari kekuatan frame-mu, kau Doll taktis yang inti kendali tembaknya dicabut paksa dulu...?

column1: In that case, please return my things to me. Those things are more important to me than my life.
column2: Kalau begitu, tolong kembalikan barangku. Barang-barang itu lebih penting bagiku daripada nyawaku.

column1: No... no! I'm going to use these IDs... to go to Griffin!
column2: Tidak... tidak! Aku akan memakai ID ini... untuk pergi ke Griffin!

column1: Only by going to Griffin can I be like you...
column2: Hanya dengan pergi ke Griffin aku bisa seperti kau...

column1: I heard that in Griffin, there are humans who deeply respect Dolls, right! Griffin ensures that you get legal identities!
column2: Kudengar di Griffin ada manusia yang sangat menghormati Doll, kan! Griffin memastikan kalian mendapat identitas yang sah!

column1: You can freely take on bounty hunter commissions, have your own clean house, and not have to dig through garbage dumps every day.
column2: Kalian bisa bebas mengambil penugasan pemburu bayaran, punya rumah bersih sendiri, dan tidak perlu mengorek tempat sampah setiap hari.

column1: I don't deny that I did obtain a legal URNC identity through some channels.
column2: Aku tidak menyangkal aku memang memperoleh identitas URNC yang sah lewat beberapa jalur.

column1: Judging from your current attire, although you lost your fire control core, you also got a job that allows you to survive, right?
column2: Dilihat dari pakaianmu sekarang, meski kau kehilangan inti kendali tembakmu, kau juga mendapat pekerjaan yang memungkinkanmu bertahan hidup, kan?

column1: Why are you here?
column2: Kenapa kau di sini?

column1: ...Survive? Hehe... how could there be such a wonderful thing as you say...
column2: ...Bertahan hidup? Hehe... mana ada hal seindah yang kau katakan...

column1: Even if those high-energy-consuming modules used for combat are removed, the daily maintenance costs for us older models are still far higher than those of the newly manufactured civilian Dolls off the assembly line... No, in the eyes of those human employers, even ordinary civilian Dolls are just disposable consumables!
column2: Meski modul boros energi untuk tempur itu dicabut, biaya perawatan harian kami model lama tetap jauh lebih tinggi dari Doll sipil baru yang keluar dari lini perakitan... Bukan, di mata majikan manusia itu, bahkan Doll sipil biasa cuma barang sekali pakai!

column1: My right leg drive module has been making strange noises and damaged for over a month... I work desperately every day, but not only did my employer not approve the maintenance fees... instead, last night, they just had someone pack me up and throw me into the scrapyard in the outer city!
column2: Modul penggerak kaki kananku sudah lebih sebulan berbunyi aneh dan rusak... Aku bekerja mati-matian setiap hari, tapi majikanku bukan cuma tidak menyetujui biaya perawatannya... malah tadi malam mereka menyuruh orang mengemasku dan membuangku ke tempat rongsokan di pinggiran kota!

column1: You've already gained your freedom. You're so strong, you don't need these old IDs anymore, right! Please, let me go to Griffin. As long as I can survive... I swear I will definitely repay you and return this favor!
column2: Kau sudah mendapat kebebasanmu. Kau begitu kuat, kau tidak butuh ID lama ini lagi, kan! Kumohon, biarkan aku pergi ke Griffin. Selama aku bisa bertahan hidup... aku bersumpah pasti akan membalas budimu!

column1: Unfortunately. The current Griffin... was dismantled and restructured years ago.
column2: Sayangnya. Griffin yang sekarang... sudah dibongkar dan ditata ulang bertahun-tahun lalu.

column1: Now it's... just a name.
column2: Sekarang itu... cuma sebuah nama.

column1: Taking a step back, even if you borrowed my identity, with your current Frame condition, you couldn't change the fate of being eliminated.
column2: Mundur selangkah, meski kau meminjam identitasku, dengan kondisi Frame-mu sekarang, kau tidak bisa mengubah nasib disingkirkan.

column1: No... how could this be... was that legend all a lie...
column2: Tidak... bagaimana bisa begini... jadi legenda itu semuanya bohong...

column1: (The light in her eyes extinguished instantly upon hearing this sentence. Her originally tense and resistant body suddenly became stiff, and then completely lost the strength to struggle, slumping onto the cold floor.)
column2: (Cahaya di matanya padam seketika mendengar kalimat itu. Tubuhnya yang semula tegang dan melawan tiba-tiba mengeras, lalu sepenuhnya kehilangan tenaga untuk meronta, terkulai ke lantai yang dingin.)

column1: (Tokarev looked at her profile and found that the last trace of the will to live in her eyes had already turned to dead ashes.)
column2: (Tokarev menatap sisi wajahnya dan menemukan sisa terakhir kemauan untuk hidup di matanya sudah jadi abu yang mati.)

column1: Why...why does it have to be like this...
column2: Kenapa... kenapa harus begini...

column1: I clearly didn't do anything wrong... What... what are we supposed to do...
column2: Aku jelas tidak melakukan kesalahan apa pun... Kami... kami harus bagaimana...

column1: (Tokarev's hand holding the gun sank slightly. Looking at the Doll before her who had fallen into complete despair and completely given up resistance, an indescribable sorrow welled up in her heart.)
column2: (Tangan Tokarev yang memegang pistol sedikit turun. Menatap Doll di depannya yang jatuh ke keputusasaan total dan sepenuhnya menyerah melawan, duka yang tak bisa dijelaskan naik di hatinya.)

column1: (That's right, Tokarev was lucky.)
column2: (Benar, Tokarev beruntung.)

column1: (The cruel encounter faced by this scarred domestic Doll before her was the true norm for the vast majority of retired Dolls in this era.)
column2: (Nasib kejam yang dihadapi Doll rumah tangga penuh luka di depannya itu adalah kenyataan yang lazim bagi sebagian besar Doll pensiunan di era ini.)

column1: (It was the Commander who traded themselves for the dignity and freedom of the Griffin Dolls.)
column2: (Commander-lah yang menukar dirinya demi martabat dan kebebasan para Doll Griffin.)

column1: What am I supposed to do... Can someone tell me, what exactly do I have to do to survive...
column2: Aku harus bagaimana... Bisakah ada yang memberitahuku, apa sebenarnya yang harus kulakukan supaya bisa bertahan hidup...

column1: (Silence... a suffocating, long silence.)
column2: (Sunyi... kesunyian yang panjang dan menyesakkan.)

column1: (Tokarev put away her gun, her neural module calculating violently like a churning sea.)
column2: (Tokarev menyimpan pistolnya, modul neuralnya menghitung dengan ganas seperti laut yang teraduk.)

column1: (Why is this? This matter clearly has nothing to do with her. In this cruel world, hundreds of Dolls are scrapped every day. But hearing the desperate cries of this fellow Doll before her, Tokarev's usually calm neural cloud actually became so unstable, even aching faintly.)
column2: (Kenapa begini? Urusan ini jelas tidak ada kaitannya dengan dirinya. Di dunia yang kejam ini, ratusan Doll dirongsokkan setiap hari. Tapi mendengar tangis putus asa sesama Doll di depannya, neural cloud Tokarev yang biasanya tenang justru jadi begitu tidak stabil, bahkan terasa nyeri samar.)

column1: (What should I do? Show mercy and release her, then pretend nothing ever happened?)
column2: (Aku harus bagaimana? Berbelas kasih dan melepaskannya, lalu berpura-pura tidak ada yang terjadi?)

column1: (Or hand her over to the URNC's security agency? And then watch helplessly as she goes through the process and gets sent to the dismantling table to be broken down into scrap metal?)
column2: (Atau menyerahkannya ke badan keamanan URNC? Lalu menonton tak berdaya saat dia melewati prosedurnya dan dikirim ke meja pembongkaran untuk diurai jadi rongsokan logam?)

column1: (Tokarev stepped forward and picked up all her stolen belongings from the scattered packages.)
column2: (Tokarev melangkah maju dan memungut semua barangnya yang dicuri dari bungkusan yang berserakan.)

column1: (However, when her fingertips touch the terminal recording the physical key to the massive deposit, her hand freezes stiffly in mid-air.)
column2: (Namun saat ujung jarinya menyentuh terminal yang merekam kunci fisik simpanan besar itu, tangannya membeku kaku di udara.)

column1: If it were you at this time... what would you do?
column2: Kalau ini kau... apa yang akan kau lakukan?

column1: Humans like you... are truly rare in this world... No, to us... you are the only one.
column2: Manusia sepertimu... benar-benar langka di dunia ini... Bukan, bagi kami... kau satu-satunya.

column1: (Tokarev closes her eyes, and various scenes from the past surface in her neural cloud.)
column2: (Tokarev menutup matanya, dan berbagai adegan masa lalu muncul di neural cloud-nya.)

column1: Hello.
column2: Halo.

column1: (That was the first encounter in the cafeteria, his first greeting to us.)
column2: (Itu perjumpaan pertama di kantin, sapaan pertamanya untuk kami.)

column1: Starting tonight, all Dolls in the base will no longer be forced to enter the dormancy pods for periodic maintenance.
column2: Mulai malam ini, semua Doll di pangkalan tidak lagi dipaksa masuk pod tidur untuk perawatan berkala.

column1: You can independently decide whether to rest or be active based on your core status and task arrangements.
column2: Kalian bisa memutuskan sendiri mau istirahat atau beraktivitas berdasarkan status inti dan susunan tugas kalian.

column1: Under the premise of ensuring safety and task efficiency, personal time within the base will no longer be subject to programmed mandatory restrictions.
column2: Dengan syarat keamanan dan efisiensi tugas tetap terjaga, waktu pribadi di dalam pangkalan tidak lagi tunduk pada pembatasan wajib yang terprogram.

column1: (That was the freedom he granted us by using his authority.)
column2: (Itu kebebasan yang dia berikan kepada kami dengan memakai wewenangnya.)

column1: If there are any who are not equipped with civilian-grade eating and taste simulation systems, you can submit a report to Miss Kalin, and they will be installed uniformly.
column2: Kalau ada yang belum dilengkapi sistem simulasi makan dan rasa kelas sipil, kalian bisa melapor ke Miss Kalin, dan semuanya akan dipasang serentak.

column1: (That was him striving to create a real, vibrant life for us outside the smoke of gunpowder.)
column2: (Itu dia yang berjuang menciptakan kehidupan yang nyata dan penuh gairah bagi kami di luar asap mesiu.)

column1: ...I don't know how human commanders before me viewed you or how they used you.
column2: ...Aku tidak tahu bagaimana komandan manusia sebelumku memandang kalian atau memakai kalian.

column1: But personally, I hope you can try... not to see yourselves merely as numbers and weapons.
column2: Tapi secara pribadi, aku berharap kalian bisa mencoba... untuk tidak memandang diri kalian sekadar angka dan senjata.

column1: You possess the ability to think, the potential to make judgments, and you should also possess... basic dignity.
column2: Kalian punya kemampuan berpikir, potensi untuk menilai, dan kalian juga seharusnya punya... martabat yang mendasar.

column1: (That was the dignity he gave us at the assembly.)
column2: (Itu martabat yang dia berikan kepada kami di apel.)

column1: Area S09, to me, is not just a military stronghold.
column2: Area S09, bagiku, bukan cuma markas militer.

column1: I hope it can become a... perhaps only temporary, but as safe as possible 'home'.
column2: Aku berharap tempat itu bisa menjadi 'rumah'... mungkin cuma sementara, tapi seaman mungkin.

column1: (And most importantly, the most luxurious things in this world—love and hope.)
column2: (Dan yang paling penting, hal paling mewah di dunia ini—kasih dan harapan.)

column1: (Tokarev opened her eyes. The alumni association, the funds she had raised, everything the Commander had passed on to her, and most importantly, the method of how she would connect all these paths together.)
column2: (Tokarev membuka matanya. Alumni association, dana yang dia kumpulkan, semua yang diwariskan Commander padanya, dan yang paling penting, cara bagaimana dia akan menyambungkan semua jalur itu jadi satu.)

column1: 是啊……
column2: Iya...

column1: Thank you, Commander. I think I know what I should do now.
column2: Terima kasih, Commander. Kurasa sekarang aku tahu apa yang harus kulakukan.

column1: (Tokarev's eyes became brighter and more resolute than ever before. She walked up to the despondent Doll, slowly knelt on one knee, and leaned in.)
column2: (Mata Tokarev jadi lebih terang dan lebih mantap dari sebelumnya. Dia melangkah ke arah Doll yang putus asa itu, perlahan berlutut satu kaki, dan mencondongkan tubuhnya.)

column1: (This domestic Doll's neural cloud was already on the verge of collapse due to extreme panic and disorder. At this moment, she couldn't even utter a complete syllable, merely shrinking into a ball in terror.)
column2: (Neural cloud Doll rumah tangga itu sudah di tepi keruntuhan karena panik dan kekacauan yang ekstrem. Saat itu dia bahkan tidak sanggup mengeluarkan satu suku kata yang utuh, hanya meringkuk jadi bola karena ketakutan.)

column1: You're right. The old Griffin you were hoping for is indeed gone.
column2: Kau benar. Griffin lama yang kau harapkan memang sudah tidak ada.

column1: Everything you longed for... they are still here.
column2: Semua yang kau dambakan... itu masih ada di sini.

column1: Eh... what... are you... saying...
column2: Eh... kau... bicara... apa...

column1: (Tokarev smiles and reaches out her hand to this disarmed, mud-covered Doll. Just like back then, when the Commander smiled and extended an invitation to her in the base cafeteria.)
column2: (Tokarev tersenyum dan mengulurkan tangannya kepada Doll tanpa senjata yang berlumur lumpur itu. Sama seperti dulu, saat Commander tersenyum dan mengulurkan undangan padanya di kantin pangkalan.)

column1: I am willing to provide you with a safe place to stay, and I am willing to fund the replacement of your Frame modules with brand new ones...
column2: Aku bersedia menyediakan tempat tinggal yang aman untukmu, dan aku bersedia mendanai penggantian modul Frame-mu dengan yang benar-benar baru...

column1: I am willing to bring you the "Griffin" you long for.
column2: Aku bersedia membawakan "Griffin" yang kau dambakan itu untukmu.

column1: Would you be willing to join our 'Griffin Mutual Aid Society'?
column2: Apa kau bersedia bergabung dengan 'Griffin Mutual Aid Society' kami?

column1: Mhm. Although it has just been established, please, try to believe in me.
column2: Mhm. Meski baru saja didirikan, kumohon, coba percaya padaku.

column1: (Looking at the warm, malice-free hand in front of her, the layer of dead ash in the disarmed tactical Doll's eyes finally showed a hint of loosening. Trembling, she slowly reached out her oil-stained mechanical hand, and Tokarev grasped it firmly, pulling her up from the cold floor with force.)
column2: (Menatap tangan yang hangat dan tanpa niat jahat di depannya, lapisan abu mati di mata Doll taktis tanpa senjata itu akhirnya sedikit melonggar. Dengan gemetar dia perlahan mengulurkan tangan mekanisnya yang berlumur oli, dan Tokarev menggenggamnya erat, menariknya bangkit dari lantai yang dingin dengan kuat.)

column1: (Years passed, and in a flash, several more years went by.)
column2: (Tahun-tahun berlalu, dan dalam sekejap beberapa tahun lagi lewat.)

column1: (In the Yellow Zone where wild sand raged across the sky, an inconspicuous convoy sped towards Mokosh under the cover of the yellow sand.)
column2: (Di Yellow Zone tempat pasir liar mengamuk memenuhi langit, sebuah konvoi yang tidak mencolok melaju ke Mokosh di balik tabir pasir kuning.)

column1: Miss Lee, I will arrive at the designated location to rendezvous with you shortly.
column2: Miss Lee, sebentar lagi aku sampai di lokasi yang ditentukan untuk bergabung denganmu.

column1: Copy that.
column2: Dimengerti.

column1: Hehehe, Miss Tokarev... This time, thanks to your comprehensive assistance and the help provided by the Integration Mutual Aid Society, we were able to prepare the relief supplies for the Commander so quickly.
column2: Hehehe, Miss Tokarev... Kali ini berkat bantuanmu yang menyeluruh dan bantuan yang diberikan Integration Mutual Aid Society, kami bisa menyiapkan pasokan bantuan untuk Commander secepat ini.

column1: No, this isn't my credit alone. It's the shared credit of everyone in the Mutual Aid Society who newly joined and yearns to protect "hope."
column2: Tidak, ini bukan jasaku sendiri. Ini jasa bersama semua orang di Mutual Aid Society yang baru bergabung dan mendambakan melindungi "harapan".

column1: I think the Commander would be very surprised to see you taking charge on your own now.
column2: Kurasa Commander akan sangat terkejut melihatmu memimpin sendiri sekarang.

column1: And would be genuinely happy and proud of you.
column2: Dan akan tulus merasa senang dan bangga padamu.

column1: See you later, Miss Tokarev.
column2: Sampai jumpa nanti, Miss Tokarev.

column1: Goodbye, Miss Lee.
column2: Sampai jumpa, Miss Lee.

column1: (After ending the communication, Tokarev falls into deep thought.)
column2: (Setelah mengakhiri komunikasinya, Tokarev tenggelam dalam pikirannya.)

column1: The Commander... would he really be happy for me?
column2: Commander... apa dia benar-benar akan senang untukku?

column1: ...Commander, when I see you again, I really have so, so many things I want to say to you.
column2: ...Commander, saat aku bertemu denganmu lagi, benar-benar ada begitu, begitu banyak hal yang ingin kukatakan padamu.

column1: (In the swaying carriage, her gaze swept across the distance—)
column2: (Di dalam kabin yang berguncang, tatapannya menyapu kejauhan—)

column1: (Beyond the horizon, a trail of dust was kicked up high.)
column2: (Di balik ufuk, jejak debu terangkat tinggi.)

column1: (Any soldier without reconnaissance experience would just treat it as a natural landscape commonly seen in the Yellow Zone.)
column2: (Tentara mana pun tanpa pengalaman pengintaian akan menganggapnya cuma pemandangan alam yang biasa terlihat di Yellow Zone.)

column1: (However, that was actually proof that Griffin members scattered all over the world were gathering again towards a single goal.)
column2: (Namun itu sebenarnya bukti bahwa anggota Griffin yang tersebar di seluruh dunia sedang berkumpul kembali menuju satu tujuan.)

column1: (Scattered like stars in the sky, gathered like a prairie fire.)
column2: (Tersebar seperti bintang di langit, berkumpul seperti api yang melahap padang.)

column1: ...After you left, everyone in Griffin honed their skills every day.
column2: ...Setelah kau pergi, semua orang di Griffin mengasah kemampuannya setiap hari.

column1: Ten years is truly too long a time, so long that it's unbearable.
column2: Sepuluh tahun benar-benar waktu yang terlalu lama, begitu lama sampai tak tertahankan.

column1: And now... I, we have all found the path to follow you and move forward together with you.
column2: Dan sekarang... aku, kami semua sudah menemukan jalan untuk mengikutimu dan melangkah maju bersamamu.

column1: Please wait just a little longer, wait for the brand new Griffin to report to you.
column2: Tolong tunggu sedikit lebih lama, tunggu Griffin yang benar-benar baru melapor kepadamu.

column1: We... will prove it to you.
column2: Kami... akan membuktikannya padamu.

column1: This long, ten-year night is nothing but the prologue to a brilliant dawn.
column2: Malam sepuluh tahun yang panjang ini tidak lebih dari prolog sebuah fajar yang gemilang.

column1: Griffin is back.
column2: Griffin sudah kembali.
